The error is at line 7, column 10: "index out of range"

Line 7 is: `else a[i-1] + SomaAte(a,i-1)`

The issue is in the function `SomaAte`. The precondition says `0 <= i <= (a.Length) + 1`, but when `i > 0`, we access `a[i-1]`. For this to be valid, we need `i-1 < a.Length`, which means `i <= a.Length`. But the precondition allows `i` to be up to `a.Length + 1`, which would make `i-1 = a.Length`, which is out of bounds.

The counterexample confirms: `a.Length = 38, i = 39`. So `i = a.Length + 1`, and `a[i-1] = a[38]` which is out of bounds since valid indices are 0 to 37.

The fix should be to change the `requires` clause of `SomaAte` from `0 <= i <= (a.Length) + 1` to `0 <= i <= a.Length`.
